name: FormCel
title: spreadsheets that agents can read and edit while you watch
summary: An open spreadsheet app with one Rust calculation engine, Excel and CSV file support, charts, PivotTables and an agent interface for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
lede: FormCel is spreadsheets in the form family, an open alternative to Excel and Google Sheets. It is built so that Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can read and edit a live workbook while you watch.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux, in the browser or as a Tauri desktop app
checks: Opens and saves .xlsx and .xlsm, opens .ods and .xls, and reads .csv, .tsv and .txt with a preview.
Calculates with one Rust engine for a store of 1,048,576 rows by 16,384 columns.
Formats cells with conditional formatting, data bars, colour scales and icon sets.
Starts from templates, including finished workbooks with a formula dashboard and charts.

facts.dd: A Rust core compiled to WebAssembly for the window and to a Python module for the FastAPI engine process on 127.0.0.1:8199
Vanilla TypeScript and Vite on http://localhost:5199, with a canvas grid
1,000,000 filled rows scroll at a 16.7 ms p95 frame with the CPU slowed 4x

chapters.title: One calculation engine, everywhere
chapters.text: A Rust core is built once for the window as WebAssembly and once for the engine process as a Python module. It holds a chunked cell store for 1,048,576 rows by 16,384 columns, with 500 steps of undo and redo.

chapters.title: Works with the files you already have
chapters.text: Open .xlsx and .xlsm or drop one on Home, and save as .xlsx. .ods opens and downloads, .xls opens with its last saved values, and password-protected .xlsx opens with its password. CSV and TSV open with a preview of separator and encoding.

chapters.title: Finished workbooks to start from
chapters.text: 76 templates ship in the gallery: 40 finished workbooks across Finance, Sales and marketing, Operations and Personal and education, and 14 Data and charts templates, each with a formula dashboard and charts tied to its data.

features.title: Home and saving
features.text: Start, Recent, Templates and Trash, after FormDeck, with thumbnails of each workbook's first sheet.
bullets: Templates with category chips and search
.fcel files in ~/FormCel/Workbooks, saved as you type
Rename in the top bar
Trash with restore

features.title: Excel files
features.text: Open and save .xlsx and .xlsm with a note of anything left out.
bullets: Values, formulas, number formats, fonts, fills, borders, alignment, cell styles, the theme and conditional formatting
.xlsm keeps its macros (not run) and downloads as .xlsm
Password-protected .xlsx opens with its password and downloads with a new one

features.title: Other files
bullets: .ods opens and downloads
.xls opens with its last saved values
.csv, .tsv and .txt with a preview, leading zeros kept
PDF of a sheet or the whole workbook

features.title: Sheets
features.text: Several sheets per workbook with tabs.
bullets: Double-click a tab to rename it
The tab menu moves, colours and deletes
Each sheet keeps its sizes, hidden rows and columns, frozen panes and zoom

features.title: Formulas
features.text: Formulas with references, operators and spilled results.
bullets: Cell, range, column, row and cross-sheet references with $ anchors
Array constants such as {1,2;3,4}
Results of several cells spill into the cells beside them, with #SPILL! when something is in the way
Formula autocomplete with argument tips

features.title: Grid
features.text: A canvas grid with headers and full keyboard support.
bullets: Selection of cells, ranges, rows, columns and the whole sheet
Name Box and formula bar
Copy, cut and paste, Paste Special, fill handle series
Group and ungroup rows and columns

features.title: Data tools
bullets: Sort A to Z or Z to A, and a multi-level Sort dialog
Filter with Ctrl+Shift+L: by values with search, or one or two conditions with And or Or and ? * wildcards

features.title: Links
bullets: Web and email addresses typed into a cell become links
Insert and Edit link (Ctrl+K) to a page, an address or a place in the workbook such as #Sheet2!A1
A chip under a linked cell to open, edit or remove it

features.title: Formatting
bullets: Greater than, less than, between, text contains, duplicates, top and bottom, above and below average, formula rules
Data bars, two- and three-colour scales and five icon sets
A rules manager with order and Stop If True
Number formats on Ctrl+Shift+~ ! @ # $ % ^

features.title: Fonts
features.text: 28 bundled fonts and all those installed on the computer, as in FormDeck.
bullets: Complete original font files for Lora, Merriweather, Playfair Display, Raleway and Source Sans 3
PDF export embeds them from those files

features.title: Data types
features.text: Stocks and Currencies data types keep their records in a workbook record store.
bullets: A cell holds only its record id and the label it shows
Field formulas such as =A2.Price
Excel export and import keep the display text, the field formulas and the data type part

features.title: Agents
features.text: An engine process that exposes commands for agents.
bullets: API at /api/commands, /api/workbooks and /api/import
Export endpoints for .xlsx, .xlsm, .ods, .csv and .tsv

parity.summary: Of 214 capabilities, FormCel is full on 183, partial on 29 and has nothing yet for 2. The baseline is graded from code at v0.40.0 against Microsoft and Google help pages, and 361 of 456 reference cells are settled from a page.

topics.title: Keys
topics.text: The README lists keyboard shortcuts including Ctrl+arrows, F2, Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y, Paste Special on Ctrl+Alt+V, and Go To on F5.

topics.title: Status table
topics.text: A table of each area of the app with what it does, from formulas and the grid to the engine process.

topics.title: Desktop app
topics.text: build_app options --open, --clean and --no-install, with .app and .dmg on macOS, .deb on Linux and .msi and setup .exe on Windows.

topics.title: Data folder
topics.text: Workbooks, trash and templates live in ~/FormCel, which FORMCEL_DATA_DIR overrides.

items: The Windows desktop app no longer opens to a blank window when the .js file type is set to text/plain in the registry
On Windows, the install no longer stops when Tesseract is missing; Data from a picture stays optional
The macOS app's engine folder is signed with the Developer ID so the app can be notarized
Windows checkouts get CRLF batch files and LF everywhere else
A test opens the built window under a slow network and processor and fails if it shifts, logs an error or has a request fail
